name: tinycast
description: Tinycast — a tiny, fully native macOS launcher, hotkeys, and clipboard history.
one_liner: A tiny, fast app launcher for Mac that pops up with one keypress and lets you search files, run commands, and access your clipboard history, a lightweight alternative to Raycast or Alfred.
buyer: An individual Mac power-user who wants a fast, free, privacy-respecting launcher and doesn't need enterprise features.
business_use_cases: A solo developer sells small, focused Raycast-style extensions built specifically for this launcher to fellow power users.
A productivity YouTuber builds an audience and affiliate income comparing it to paid launcher alternatives.
Honestly, most of the value here is personal productivity, not something a company can be built on top of.

money_ideas.idea: Accept tips and sponsorships from users (already built in) and grow toward a small pro-support tier

steal_this: This weekend, build and publish one well-made extension for it and list it for tips; the realistic ceiling here is a side income, not a company.
